0022600193.text: The Orlando Magic (2-6, on a three-game losing streak) are 0-4 at home and sit 12th in the East, while the Golden State Warriors (6-3, on a six-game winning streak) are 4-1 at home and 2nd in the Pacific, 1 game back. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1 and have not met yet in 2026-27, with the last meeting coming on December 22, 2025, in San Francisco, where the Magic lost 120-97. Orlando is missing Paolo Banchero (ankle, sprain), Jalen Suggs (knee), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jonathan Isaac (knee), and Noah Penda (hamstring, strain), while Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee, surgery), and Draymond Green (elbow, inflammation), Gary Payton II (calf), and Gui Santos (knee) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions.
